integrity: The 45 tritangent vertices are regenerated from Picard divisor data; the comparator is reproduced from a specific published 45-by-45 binary adjacency matrix; exact full-rank reduced determinants and 3-adic/5-adic Smith valuations are checked from three deleted vertices for each graph. The independent scientific audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Integral combinatorial critical groups of two specified 45-vertex graphs, not surface Picard groups, not all 78 parameter-matched graphs, and not arithmetic or positive-characteristic descent. Historical priority remains provisional.
title: Integral critical groups of cubic-surface tritangent planes and a cospectral quadrangle mate
